options.text: When moving air carries the lighter husk farther while heavier grains fall closer.
When the air is still, if he shakes the mixture hard enough.
When the heavier wheat grains travel farther in the wind than the light husk.
When the two parts only look different in colour but have the same weight.

stem:
Alok helps clean freshly threshed wheat outdoors. He wants to separate light husk from heavier wheat grains.

When can winnowing work?

teacher.key_rationale: Winnowing needs moving air so lighter husk is carried farther while heavier grains fall closer. Still air, reversed travel, or colour alone without a weight difference will not do it.
